generator.params.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 153-154), Cycas thouarsii: stems 4 to 10 m tall, 20 to 45 cm across; about 40 leaves a flush, 1.5 to 3 m long, the petiole 30 to 40 cm; leaflets in 60 to 70 pairs, 20 to 38 cm by 7 to 20 mm. Drawn as a trunk 0.16 m in radius, rising 0.09 m a year; fronds 2.25 m long, the petiole 0.16 of them, 64 pairs of leaflets, the longest leaflet 0.13 of the frond; 13 fronds a year, as the crown's count over the three years a frond lives (estimated); first cones at 8 years (estimated, as the research note's timing table records). Its sporophylls hang once its seeds are ripe (p. 153): 115 degrees from upright.

appearance.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 153-154), Cycas thouarsii: its leaflets drawn as wide, for their length, as the median leaflets it gives; the rest of its look from its order and family.

allometry.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 153-154), Cycas thouarsii: stems 4 to 10 m tall, 20 to 45 cm across; about 40 leaves a flush, 1.5 to 3 m long, the petiole 30 to 40 cm; leaflets in 60 to 70 pairs, 20 to 38 cm by 7 to 20 mm. The whole plant's height at 60 years estimated from these, its stem (or none, where it stays underground) under a crown of young leaves standing about 0.85 of a leaf above it: about 7 m. Whitelock gives no ages, so the tolerance is wide.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit: a cycad's crown of pinnate leaves on a pachycaul stem, drawn on the palm program.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact: four seeds, so male and female plants both show.

traits.pollen_cone_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 153-154), Cycas thouarsii: male cone oblong-cylindrical, 30 to 60 cm long.

traits.pollen_cone_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 153-154), Cycas thouarsii: male cone 11 to 20 cm across.

traits.pollen_cone_face_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 154), Cycas thouarsii: microsporophylls wedge-shaped, 3.5 to 5 cm long, the face about 2 cm wide.

traits.pollen_cone_shape.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 153-154), Cycas thouarsii: male cone oblong-cylindrical.

traits.pollen_cone_colour.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 153-154), Cycas thouarsii: male cone densely yellowish-orange felted; the colour by eye.

traits.microsporophyll_spine_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 153-154), Cycas thouarsii: microsporophylls wedge-shaped, 3.5 to 5 cm, the face about 2 cm wide, with a gently upturned spine 3 to 8 mm.

traits.megasporophyll_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 153-154), Cycas thouarsii: megasporophylls to 35 cm long, pendent when the seed is ripe.

traits.megasporophyll_crown.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 153-154), Cycas thouarsii: megasporophylls open, hanging when the seeds ripen.

traits.megasporophyll_margin.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 153-154), Cycas thouarsii: lamina ovate-lanceolate and acuminate, 7 to 10 cm by 3 cm, subentire to minutely scalloped; read as entire.

traits.megasporophyll_colour.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 153-154), Cycas thouarsii: megasporophylls densely orange-brown felted; the colour by eye.

traits.ovules_per_megasporophyll.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 153-154), Cycas thouarsii: 8 to 10 ovules.

traits.seed_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 153-154), Cycas thouarsii: seeds broadly ovoid, slightly flattened, 4.7 to 5.4 cm long.

traits.seed_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 153-154), Cycas thouarsii: seeds 3.7 to 4.4 cm across.

traits.seed_colour_ripe.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 153-154), Cycas thouarsii: sarcotesta brick red when ripe; the colour by eye.

traits.sexual_system.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 153-154), Cycas thouarsii: male and female cones on separate plants, as in every cycad (p. 19).
